description: Source code for the Emergency Access Daemon (ead), implementing network packet handling, authentication, and command execution over UDP using pcap, with bridge and interface management.

methods.name: ead_open_pcap
methods.description: Creates and configures a pcap handle for a network interface, with optional promiscuous mode and protocol filtering.

methods.name: get_random_bytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes from /dev/urandom.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Reads and processes the password file to generate a salted password hash for authentication.

methods.name: chksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum over a data buffer, used for IP header checksum.

methods.name: ead_send_packet_clone
methods.description: Clones and sends a network packet, adjusting IP and UDP headers, and recalculating checksums.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Transitions the internal state machine of the daemon, initializing or progressing authentication steps.

methods.name: handle_ping
methods.description: Handles ping messages, responding with a pong containing device name and auth type.

methods.name: handle_set_username
methods.description: Processes a request to set the username for authentication.

methods.name: handle_get_prime
methods.description: Handles the request to send a prime number and salt for Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: handle_send_a
methods.description: Processes the client's public key part in Diffie-Hellman exchange.

methods.name: handle_send_auth
methods.description: Verifies client authentication and responds with authentication result.

methods.name: handle_send_cmd
methods.description: Executes commands received from the client, supporting normal, background, and keepalive modes.

methods.name: parse_message
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to appropriate handlers based on message type.

methods.name: handle_packet
methods.description: Processes captured network packets, filtering for relevant UDP packets and passing them for message parsing.

methods.name: ead_pcap_reopen
methods.description: Reopens pcap handles, applying filters and handling interface/bridge changes.

methods.name: ead_pktloop
methods.description: Main packet processing loop, dispatching packets via pcap.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the daemon.

methods.name: server_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD signals, cleaning up child process PIDs.

methods.name: instance_handle_sigchld
methods.description: Handles SIGCHLD for child process termination.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a network interface server, forking if necessary, and running packet processing.

methods.name: start_servers
methods.description: Starts all configured server instances.

methods.name: stop_server
methods.description: Stops a server instance, optionally freeing its resources.

methods.name: server_handle_sigint
methods.description: Handles SIGINT to gracefully shut down all server instances.

methods.name: check_bridge_port
methods.description: Associates network ports with bridges, updating configuration.

methods.name: check_bridge
methods.description: Iterates over bridge ports to verify and assign interfaces.

methods.name: check_all_interfaces
methods.description: Checks and updates the status of all network interfaces and bridge associations.
